instruction_zh: 选1，按新的收录边界建立组件检索验收，保留原120题及真实成绩。验收通过后继续搭建和部署网站，保持完全免费、Agent优先，素材尽量在云端处理，不要整库下载到本地。
unchanged_requirements: Complete component retrieval and existing material, scope, rights, appearance, diversity and recovery acceptance before website implementation.
Keep excluded and pending-scope material outside public search, downloads and release contents.
Do not infer scientific identity, species, procedure or editing capability from filenames, broad geometry or successful search alone.
Use actual previews and sources to judge returned results; component combinations are not proof of completed scientific procedures.
Preserve originals and attribution; selected-asset text cleanup is a later skill operation, not a whole-library job.
Keep hosting and processing completely free, prioritize agents, and never download the entire artwork library locally.
